subject.title: feat(signal): add setup wizard container flow

question: Should OpenClaw land the guided Signal Docker setup after conflict resolution, narrow it to the setup/status repairs, or pause the managed Docker setup expansion?
rationale: The previous receive-readiness defect is mechanically addressed, but the remaining choice is product and compatibility acceptance for new setup/config/Docker behavior plus a dirty merge state.

options.title: Resolve and continue guided setup
options.body: Rebase or otherwise resolve conflicts, preserve current-main hardening, refresh proof, and continue toward landing the guided Docker setup in this PR.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Keep only the setup rollback, status, and account-scoped config repairs maintainers want now, and defer managed Docker setup to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the expansion
options.body: Hold or close the branch if maintainers do not want OpenClaw-owned managed Docker setup behavior for Signal right now.

recommendation.title: Resolve and continue guided setup
recommendation.body: Rebase or otherwise resolve conflicts, preserve current-main hardening, refresh proof, and continue toward landing the guided Docker setup in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across setup wizard boundaries and the related merged Signal container runtime PR.
